name: Onboarding Tour nav item opens the per-repo tour and renders all 5 sections
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click the 'Onboarding Tour' WORKSPACE nav item (D1) and confirm the /repos/:repoId/onboarding route renders the 'Onboarding for ...' heading plus the 5 canonical section headings, in order (Architecture / Critical paths / How to run locally / Guided reading path / First tasks). The seeded demo repo has no repo-intel index, so the tour degrades to the deterministic skeleton on first view (AC-5) — zero model calls, fully deterministic. Exercises the new per-repo Onboarding Tour route + nav wiring (AC-16), distinct from the existing top-level /onboarding Add-Repo screen covered by 06.
